kiel-probstei-hohwacht-eutin-flow.title: Kiel · Probstei, Hohwacht and Eutin Flow
kiel-probstei-hohwacht-eutin-flow.slogan: A good northern day: fields, bay air, lake roads and no motorway boredom.
kiel-probstei-hohwacht-eutin-flow.story: A good northern day: fields, bay air, lake roads and no motorway boredom. The best part sits around Probstei villages, Hohwacht bay, Lütjenburg reset, while the most useful town stop keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.

scenicChapters.title: Hohwacht bay → Lütjenburg reset
scenicChapters.narrative: 15 km through ground somebody thought worth listing. The road passes it rather than bypassing it — speed drops and stays down. Park rather than crawl through.

scenicChapters.title: Lütjenburg reset → Eutin lake
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 41 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
